caseName: UNITED RAILROAD WORKERS DIVISION OF TRANSPORT WORKERS UNION OF AMERICA v. Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Co.
caseNameFull: UNITED RAILROAD WORKERS DIVISION OF TRANSPORT WORKERS UNION OF AMERICA Et Al. v. BALTIMORE & OHIO RAILROAD CO. Et Al.
attorneys: George Halpern, Edith Lowenstein, Carl E. Newton, Yelverton Cowherd and Alfred D. Treherne for petitioners., Joseph P. Allen for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded for reconsideration in light of Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers et al. v. Missouri-Kansas-Texas R. Co., 363 U. S. 528.
